data.title: 克莱尔 · 学园长椅的午后红茶分享
data.description: 魔剑士学园林荫中庭的石制长椅上，微风和煦。克莱尔将带来的保温壶倒入小茶杯，微红着脸颊递给身边的少年。
data.location: shady courtyard path of Midgar Academy with stone bench beneath trees
data.action: sitting on courtyard stone bench, pouring black tea from thermos into porcelain cup, offering cup forward, blushing softly with fond tsundere expression
data.lighting: soft afternoon sunlight filtering through courtyard trees with warm reflections
data.mood: sweet school romance, caring elder-sister warmth, peaceful campus afternoon
data.promptProse: On a stone bench in the shaded courtyard of Midgar Academy, Claire Kagenou pours warm black tea from a thermos into a teacup and offers it forward, her cheeks flushed with tender affection.
data.animaCaption: Offering a warm cup of black tea on the campus courtyard stone bench, she smiles with fond affection.
